input.quote: Charges for applicable Services will be specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms. Charges can be specified as one-time, installment, recurring, or usage. IBM will invoice such Charges when they begin or are due as set forth in Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment, committed volume, take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic. Charges under § 4.1 arise only for Services actually ordered (via Order Forms and Service Option Attachments) and are specified as one-time, installment, recurring or usage, so Customer pays only for usage or ordered Services — the preferred position. Targeted searches for "minimum", "commit to purchase", "take or pay", "shortfall" and usage/volume caps returned nothing, and § 11.5 (Capacity Planning) only allocates responsibility for sizing capacity, imposing no committed capacity on Customer. Customer additionally holds an exit under § 3.4 (termination for convenience on one month's notice at the end of any calendar month), and § 3.2 renewal is terminable by either party on 90 days' notice. Minor point noted only: § 3.4(b) refers to early termination charges "if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments" — Attachment A is not included in the reviewed text, so we should confirm on diligence that no early termination charge operates as a de facto commitment. That contingent reference is not itself a minimum commitment and does not warrant a redline.
